summary: TXNM Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the pricing and closing of an underwritten public offering of 7,079,646 shares of common stock at a purchase price of $55.935 per share, raising net proceeds of approximately $396 million after underwriting discounts and expenses. The offering was made under an existing S-3 registration statement, with Wells Fargo Securities as sole underwriter. Net proceeds are intended to repay borrowings under a $400 million term loan. This is a routine capital-raising transaction by the issuer, not a special-situation event.
